name: Zhangping Shui Xian
pluckStandard: open leaf, pressed into a small square

processing.description: Fujian inland oolong wither on Shui Xian leaf — the same cultivar as Wuyi, a different shape.
摇青 starts oxidation at the margin. Oolong is this verb, then a roast.
Fired when the floral peak is in.
Not a Wuyi strip and not an Anxi bead — prepared for the square.
Pressed into a small paper-wrapped square. Unique among oolongs in this atlas; the press is the tell on the table.
Medium roast; orchid and water-lily over charcoal sweetness.

profile.mouthfeel: thicker than jade TGY, less rock than Wuyi Shui Xian

rinses.notes: rinse to open the square; the first drinking steep is still ahead

water.note: Near boiling, moderate minerals. Ultra-soft water makes the square taste thin.

storage: Airtight after roast has settled. The squares keep if dry.

shelfLife.window: improves for a while after roast

qualityMarkers.claim: Zhangping, not a Wuyi strip in a box

commonFaults.name: Wuyi Shui Xian crumbs pressed and relabelled

compare.differentiator: Same cultivar name. Wuyi Shui Xian is a rock strip; Zhangping is a pressed square from inland Fujian. The mountain is the argument.

summary: The square oolong: Zhangping Shui Xian, paper-wrapped, orchid over a medium roast, not a Wuyi strip.
